categories.description: Literary or general fiction, including realistic novels and short stories. Exclude nonfiction; do not use this as an automatic umbrella tag for every genre novel.
categories.name: Fiction

categories.description: Fiction centered on solving a crime, investigating a mystery or identifying a culprit.
categories.name: Mystery

categories.description: Dark crime fiction centered on criminals, corruption, moral ambiguity or social decay. A bleak atmosphere alone is insufficient.
categories.name: Noir

categories.description: Fiction in which magic, imaginary worlds, mythical creatures or supernatural forces are central.
categories.name: Fantasy

categories.description: Fiction centered on scientific speculation, future technologies, time travel, extraterrestrial life or speculative societies.
categories.name: Science Fiction

categories.description: Fiction intended primarily to evoke fear or dread through monsters, supernatural threats or disturbing events.
categories.name: Horror

categories.description: Fiction centered on journeys, exploration, survival, quests or action-driven exploits.
categories.name: Adventure

categories.description: Fiction set in a past historical period where historical events or conditions are central. Exclude historical nonfiction and novels merely old today.
categories.name: Historical Fiction

categories.description: Nonfiction about past events, civilizations, historical people or historical developments. Exclude historical fiction.
categories.name: History

categories.description: Nonfiction biographies, autobiographies, memoirs and personal life accounts.
categories.name: Biography & Memoir

categories.description: Nonfiction explaining natural science, scientific discoveries or scientific research. Exclude science fiction and computing manuals.
categories.name: Science

categories.description: Nonfiction about philosophical ideas, ethics, political thought, government or social and political arguments.
categories.name: Philosophy & Politics

categories.description: Collections of poems or works primarily written as poetry or verse. Exclude ordinary prose fiction.
categories.name: Poetry

categories.description: General essays and nonfiction that do not primarily fit another configured nonfiction subject. Exclude fiction and subject-specific technical manuals.
categories.name: Essays & Nonfiction

categories.description: Nonfiction about computers, operating systems, software development, programming, networking or computing tools. May coexist with a more specific computing tag.
categories.name: Computing

categories.description: Practical or theoretical nonfiction about writing software, programming languages, algorithms, testing or development tools, including version control.
categories.name: Programming

categories.description: Nonfiction primarily about artificial intelligence, machine learning, neural networks or AI systems. Incidental mentions of AI are insufficient.
categories.name: Artificial Intelligence

categories.description: Nonfiction primarily about computational data analysis, statistics for data analysis, data visualization or data science workflows.
categories.name: Data Science
